description:
Resolve tradeable RS3 names to GE IDs. Use search_wiki for quests, NPCs or guides; non-GE items cannot match here.

- query="Abyssal whip" tries an exact match; "abyssal" discovers alternatives. An exact match ends the search regardless of limit.
- limit also bounds Wiki candidates checked against Weirdgloop. Non-GE candidates are discarded, so results can be fewer; increasing limit widens that screening. Values outside 1–10 error before fetching rather than being clamped.
- Pass a chosen ID to get_item_details for current records, get_price_series for history, or estimate_flip for profit math. No matches is a tool error; optional price/volume fields may be absent and samples lag activity.
- Reads are uncached and need no credentials. HTTP defaults to 60 requests/IP/minute; wait for Retry-After after 429.
